title: Steam & Sprawl
description: Forge machines, tame wilds, and explore expansive worlds! A Create-focused adventure modpack blending intricate automation with rich exploration and cozy building
body:
# Steam & Sprawl

**Steam & Sprawl** is a meticulously crafted Minecraft modpack designed to blend the intricate wonders of the **Create mod** with expansive world-generation, enhanced combat, and a touch of cozy domesticity. Whether you dream of building a fully automated industrial empire or embarking on grand adventures through breathtaking landscapes, Steam & Sprawl offers a rich, balanced experience for both solo players and small groups.

## Key Features

* **Create Mod Unleashed:** Dive deep into the core mechanics of the [Create Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) and its powerful addons like Create Addition, Create Enchantment Industry, and Create Dragons Plus. Build intricate factories, automate resources, design custom transport, and create dynamic contraptions limited only by your imagination.

* **Expansive & Enhanced Worlds:** Explore a vastly overhauled Overworld and Nether! Discover new structures, biomes, and revamped dungeons with **Yung's Better Series**, **Moogs Voyager Structures**, **Dungeons and Taverns**, and new natural biomes from **Ecologics** and the **Let's Do!** series.

* **Refined Adventure & Combat:** Experience more dynamic combat with **Better Combat** and **Simply Swords**. Navigate effortlessly with **Xaero's World Map & Minimap**, and tame critters with **Mob Lassos** as you venture into the unknown.

* **Cozy Homesteads & Creative Building:** Design your perfect base with extensive decorative options from **Another Furniture**, **Handcrafted**, **Beautify**, and **Supplementaries**. Become a master chef with **Farmer's Delight** and its many addons, cultivating a thriving homestead.

* **Optimized & Immersive Performance:** Enjoy a smooth gameplay experience thanks to performance mods like **Sodium (with Iris for shaders!)**, **Lithium**, and **ImmediatelyFast**. Immerse yourself with enhanced audio from **Ambient Sounds** and **Sound Physics Remastered**.

* **New Creatures & Companions:** Encounter refreshed mob models, new adorable animal friends from **Critters & Companions**, **Adorable Hamster Pets**, and **Realistic Bees**, adding life and personality to your world.

## Modpack Direction

Steam & Sprawl aims to provide a cohesive experience where the ingenious automation of the **Create mod** takes center stage, empowering players to build and innovate. This mechanical mastery is beautifully complemented by a sprawling, detailed world begging to be explored. Whether you're constructing a steam-powered farm, automating an ancient temple, or simply building a cozy home amidst new biomes, every aspect of the modpack encourages discovery and creativity.

The mod selection focuses on enhancing vanilla gameplay without deviating too far, ensuring a familiar yet vastly expanded experience. From quality-of-life improvements to comprehensive world overhauls and new gameplay mechanics, **Steam & Sprawl** is an invitation to build, explore, and thrive in a world that constantly offers new challenges and creative opportunities.
